name: United Stables
oneLiner: U is a BVI-issued dollar stablecoin backed by a variable mix of cash, U.S. Treasury bills, and approved fiat-referenced stablecoins.
collateral: Variable reserve mix of cash, U.S. Treasury bills, and fiat-referenced stablecoins approved by United Stables.
pegMechanism: Smart contracts mint U 1:1 only upon receipt of USD or whitelisted stablecoins (USDC, USDT, USD1); redemption burns U and returns USD or stablecoins; on-chain oracles enforce total supply never exceeds collateral

proofOfReserves.provider: Chainlink Proof of Reserve feed on BNB Chain (u-por, linked from the issuer PoR page since July 2026; Ceffu provides custody per Ceffu's announcement, but no downloadable custodian attestation was retrievable and the feed's heartbeat/source metadata could not be verified)

slice.name: Cash, U.S. Treasury bills, and fiat-referenced stablecoins (variable mix)
